name: WARDED ARMOUR
text: Each turning point, as a strategic gambit, a friendly Legionary's Save becomes 2+ until the Ready step of the next Strategy phase.

name: MALEFIC BLADES
text: Every friendly Legionary carries a malefic blade (Atk 5, Hit 3+, Dmg 3/4) for the battle.

name: TAINTED ROUNDS
text: One Shoot per turning point, a Legionary firing a plain bolt pistol or boltgun may load cursed rounds: that gun gains Rending for the rest of the action. The tainted bolt pistol does not qualify.

name: CHAOS TALISMANS
text: A strategic gambit each turning point: name a Mark of Chaos. A Legionary of that mark with at least two failed attack dice may, once per activation, take D3 damage to throw one fail away and count another as a normal success.
